name: JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown
positioning: Downtown Atlanta hotel with a rooftop pool, a rooftop bar and a 16th-floor spa, close to Centennial Olympic Park
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base near the Georgia Aquarium, Centennial Olympic Park and Mercedes-Benz Stadium
Guests who want a rooftop pool and a spa in the city

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Atlanta, moments from Mercedes-Benz Stadium, the Georgia Aquarium and Centennial Olympic Park.
Guest rooms and suites are spacious and airy, with warm, modern finishes.
Some guest rooms have panoramic Atlanta views.
Suites on the Mindful floor have plush bedding and marble bathrooms.
Some rooms come with executive lounge access.
Spa services include couples massages, body scrubs and eye treatments.
The fitness center is open around the clock, with free weights, cardio and boxing.
Ledger Bar and Lounge is a cocktail lounge that blends corporate architecture with Southern hospitality.

highlights.text: A rooftop pool looks out over the Atlanta skyline.
Nest Spa, on the 16th floor, offers massages, facials and other treatments, with separate men's and women's lounges.
The Perch is a rooftop bar and restaurant serving fresh seafood and shareable small plates with skyline views.
Suites on the Mindful floor have plush bedding and marble bathrooms.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have fridges, and rollaway beds are not permitted.
WhataHotel notes the downtown setting means city noise and traffic.
